Two families · Eight friends · One snowy weekend

Snow Days
in the Poconos

A cozy cabin a mile from the slopes, a whole day of flying down one of Pennsylvania's biggest snow-tubing hills, and hot cocoa by the fire.

📅 Fri Jan 22 – Sun Jan 24, 2027 📍 Tannersville, PA 💵 About $875–$1,000 per family
Why this weekend

The perfect winter escape, close to home

Late January is the heart of Poconos winter: the deepest snow, the coldest air, and none of the holiday crowds or holiday prices. Everything we need is within a few minutes of the cabin.

❄️

Peak snow

The coldest stretch of the year, and the park makes its own snow, so the lanes are fast and full.

🛷

40+ tubing lanes

Camelback has one of the biggest tubing parks around, plus glowing night tubing after dark.

🏡

Room for everyone

A four-bedroom house that sleeps all eight of us, with a fireplace and a big kitchen.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦

No holiday markup

It's after MLK weekend, so prices and crowds are back to normal.

The main event

A day at Camelback Snowtubing

Two-hour sessions on giant inner tubes, with a moving carpet that carries you back up the hill so the kids can go again and again. After sunset, the lanes light up in color for night tubing.

Side-by-side lanes, so the whole group can race to the bottom
Pure joy, every run
Glow tubing after dark
Tubes are included in the ticket
Kids 44 inches and taller can ride solo
⭐ OUR TOP PICK

The Ski Side Getaway

Less than a mile from the tubing park. You could almost see it from the porch.

  • 🛏️ 4 bedrooms, 8 beds, 2½ baths. Everyone gets a real bed
  • 🔥 Gas fireplace for cocoa and card games
  • 📍 0.7 miles to Camelback, about a 2-minute drive
  • ⭐ 4.91 stars from 93 guest reviews
  • ✅ Free cancellation was offered when we checked
$813 for both nights, taxes included (estimated)
That's about $407 per family.

The weekend at a glance

Three days, zero stress

Friday

Arrive & settle in

Drive up after school, check in, order pizza, and claim bedrooms in front of the fireplace.

Saturday

Tubing day

A big breakfast, then a two-hour session at Camelback. Head back for hot cocoa, or go again at night for glow tubing.

Sunday

Slow morning, easy drive

Pancakes, one last snowball fight, and home by afternoon. You can add a Sunday-morning tubing session if the kids beg.

Simple, split two ways

Everything for all eight people, split evenly between the two families. Tubing prices for this season aren't out yet, so those use last season's rates.

Let's make it happen

Book the cabin by November 1st

Four-bedroom houses near Camelback go fast for January weekends. Tubing tickets go on sale in November and tend to sell out for Saturdays.

How to get it done

Four easy steps

Agree on the plan

Both families confirm the dates, the budget, and the kids' heights. Riders under 44 inches share a tube with an adult.

Book the cabin

By Nov 1. Pick a free-cancellation listing and note the cancellation deadline.

Grab 8 tickets

When Camelback's tickets go on sale, buy all eight in one order for the same session.

Sign waivers & go

Everyone signs online the week of the trip. Check the snow report two days before you leave.

Good to know

Backup weekends and the fine print

  • Backup weekends: Jan 8–10 (about $910–1,030 per family) or Jan 29–31 (about $900–1,020 per family). Both cost about the same as our main pick.
  • Cabin prices were checked live on Airbnb on October 12, 2026, for 4 adults and 4 kids. Taxes, about 9%, are an estimate added at checkout. Prices can change until you book.
  • Tubing prices for 2026–27 haven't been published. We budgeted $70–85 per person based on last season. Kids pay full price.
  • Weather: Late January is the safest time of year for snow. If Saturday gets rained out, we can move to Sunday morning, try Blue Mountain or Big Boulder, or move to a backup weekend before the cancellation deadline.
  • Nothing has been booked or paid for yet. This brochure is a plan for us to agree on.
